home.title: Welcome
home.subtitle: Skeleton of the hybrid food and weight-loss diary app.
home.stackNote: Runs from one codebase on iOS, Android and the web (Expo + React Native + react-native-web).
home.phaseNote: Skeleton for now. Features arrive phase by phase per docs/zadani.md.
home.setGoalFirst: Set your goal to see how today is going.

onboarding.title: Let's set your goal
onboarding.subtitle: A few details and we'll compute your daily intake and macros.
onboarding.errorBirthDate: Enter a valid date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD.
onboarding.errorHeight: Height must be between 100 and 250 cm.
onboarding.errorRate: Pace can be at most 1 kg per week.
onboarding.errorTargetWeight: Target weight is too low. The lowest acceptable is {weight} kg.

activity.very_high: Physical job or hard daily training

goal.title: Your daily goal
goal.warningRate: The chosen pace is not safely achievable with these parameters, so the goal is set to a safe limit. Consider consulting a doctor or a nutrition therapist.

diary.title: Diary
diary.empty: No entries yet. Search a food and add it.

mood.hungry: Don't forget to log a meal.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Sign in to save your goal and diary.

attribution.off: Food data © Open Food Facts contributors, ODbL license.

photo.title: Meal photo
photo.estimate: This is an estimate, not a measurement. Check and adjust before saving.
photo.notFood: I can't see food in this photo.
photo.rateLimited: Today's photo analysis limit is reached.
photo.aboutBody: Pick a photo of your meal and the app uses AI to estimate the individual foods, their weight and nutrition. Review each item, adjust the grams if needed, then log the selected items to your diary with one tap. It is an estimate, not a precise measurement – treat it as a helper.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.name: Recipe name
recipes.empty: Add ingredients and we'll compute the per-portion nutrition.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.intro: Phased hydration schedule and main meals. At most 8 notifications a day.
reminders.webNote: On the web this is only a preview. Notifications are scheduled in the mobile app.
reminders.denied: Without notification permission they can't be scheduled.
reminders.emailNote: On the web we send reminders by e-mail to your account address.
reminders.pushNote: Push notifications are coming soon – e-mail works reliably for now.
reminders.weighBody: We remind you only if you have not weighed in for 7 days. Best in the morning, fasted, same day and time.

escalation.title: Let's take a different approach
escalation.body: Your recent data suggests a sustained low intake. This app isn't the right tool for that. You're not alone and help is available.

account.title: Account & data
account.needSignIn: Sign in to manage your account and data.
account.exportDesc: Download a copy of all your personal data as JSON.
account.deleteDesc: Permanently deletes your account and all data. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirmQuestion: Really delete your account? Data will be gone for good.
account.error: Something went wrong, please try again.

food.createPrompt: Not found? Create your own food.
food.title: New food

plans.title: Meal plans
plans.needSignIn: Sign in to create meal plans.
plans.empty: No plan yet. Create your first.
plans.aboutBody: A plan is a menu for 1 to 4 weeks ahead. Create a plan, assign foods or saved recipes to each day and meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack). When the day comes, the „Transfer day to diary“ button logs the whole planned day in one tap. Nothing is logged automatically – the plan is just a template you confirm.
plans.aiNeedGoal: Set your goal in onboarding first.
plans.aiHint: Untick what does not fit, then add selected to the day.
